scenarios.title: A devour permanent enters with N +1/+1 counters per creature sacrificed
decisions: A casts Gorger Wurm, tapping three Mountains and two Forests.
Both players pass; Gorger Wurm resolves.
As it enters, A sacrifices one Grizzly Bears to devour.

variants.label: devour_one
variants.expected: Gorger Wurm (5/5, devour 1) enters with one +1/+1 counter, a 6/6. One Grizzly Bears is in A's graveyard; the other stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: devour_two
variants.delta: A sacrifices both Grizzly Bears as Gorger Wurm enters.
variants.expected: Gorger Wurm enters with two +1/+1 counters, a 7/7. Both Grizzly Bears are in A's graveyard.

variants.label: devour_none
variants.delta: A sacrifices no creatures as Gorger Wurm enters.
variants.expected: Gorger Wurm enters with no counters, a 5/5. Both Grizzly Bears stay on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Devour with a quality counts only sacrificed permanents of that quality
decisions: A casts Caprichrome, tapping four Plains.
As it enters, A sacrifices every permanent it may sacrifice for devour artifact.

variants.label: artifact_available
variants.expected: Caprichrome (2/2, devour artifact 1) sacrifices Bonesplitter and enters with one +1/+1 counter, a 3/3. Bonesplitter is in A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_artifact
variants.delta: Bonesplitter is not on A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not an artifact and cannot be devoured. Caprichrome enters with no counters, a 2/2, and Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.
